title: How to improve Test Charlie
author: Jesper Poulsen
desc: Test charlie is a military test in Denmark where you have to score a certain amount of points in order to be able to be sent out on operations. Therefore this program is to people who wants to improve their test charlie scores in order to score the highest amount possible.
